'''Hattak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' during the [[Attack on the Brentaal Star]] by the [[Gage-class transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]''. Hattak was in a boarding party against that vessel, accompanied by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Boran]], [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Keemos]] and [[S1-M0]]. They defended their boarding shuttle against a counterattack by an Imperial strike team, but after were all killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Hattak appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Black Talon" flashpoint only if player choose the ''Light Side'' option during their conversation with Captain [[Revinal Orzik|Orzik]], keeping him alive.
